# @stackline/source-map-resolve

Compatibility-first continuation of source-map-resolve@0.6.0. Runtime: Node.js >=12 and browsers. Seven CommonJS functions are preserved; ESM, TypeScript declarations, and browser artifacts are additive. The 0.5.3 baseline covers shared ordinary behavior only.

Version 1.0.1 has no production, optional, or peer dependencies. It preserves
the historical direct and npm-alias import paths.
